items.title: Jonathan Scales interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 23, 2025
items.q: I saw that it was Danny Elfman who wrote the music.

ctx.x: talk about your father and your insistence that you were going to have a peanut butter and jelly sandwich. And eventually for our listeners, the story ended up you got it, and you wouldn’t give up. So I’m wondering if your father later on was supportive of your path of I want to be a musician? How did he feel about that?

Oh yeah. My parents were extremely supportive of me pursuing music and this is a really big deal. And I didn’t realize it was a big deal because that’s how I grew up. My parents were supportive of me. And I didn’t realize until I got to college and out of college when I talked to other people when I realized that other people’s parents weren’t supportive. That was blowing my mind. You know what I mean? Like when I was getting into music, any time I sparked an interest in something I think my parents knew that…
That’s fabulous. And they didn’t say, “Okay go for music but why don’t you get a teaching degree and you can fall back on it.”
